Footprint first crosses the measured soft-verge edge, supported by paint/wheel silhouette at the snow/asphalt boundary. Timing +/-2 frames; this is verge encroachment, not proof of a rigid hedge/barrier impact. Static impulse is unidentifiable and is intentionally omitted. Steering, sliding and soft-ground resistance cannot be separated from this view.
